title: B1 dan B2 ga: nimalar o‘zgaradi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida B2 ning uchta asosiy mezonini (ravonlik, aniqlik, boylik) tushuntirasiz, B1 platosidan chiqish rejasini tuzasiz va o‘z ikki daqiqalik nutqingizni mezonlar bo‘yicha baholay olasiz.

scenes.title: B1 dan B2 ga: yangi bosqich
scenes.say: Welcome to the upper-intermediate level. Today we look at what really changes between B1 and B2, and how to plan your progress.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum va B2 darajasiga xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda B1 yakuniy imtihonini topshirdingiz, bu katta yutuq. Bugun yangi bosqichda sizdan aynan nima talab qilinishini, nega ko‘pchilik B1 da to‘xtab qolishini va bu devordan qanday o‘tishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida o‘z nutqingizni B2 mezonlari bo‘yicha o‘zingiz baholay olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yuqori o‘rta darajaga xush kelibsiz. Bugun B1 va B2 o‘rtasida aslida nima o‘zgarishini va rivojlanishni qanday rejalashtirishni ko‘ramiz.

scenes.title: B1 da nima qila olardingiz
board: B1: familiar topics, simple connected speech

examples.t: I like my job because it is interesting.
examples.uz: Ishim menga yoqadi, chunki u qiziq.

scenes.say: At B1 you can talk about familiar topics. You can describe an experience and give a short reason for an opinion.
scenes.say_native: B1 da siz tanish mavzularda gapira olasiz: o‘z tajribangizni tasvirlaysiz, fikringizga qisqa sabab keltirasiz. Ovqat buyurtma qilish, sayohatda muammoni hal qilish, ish haqida oddiy suhbat — bularning hammasi sizga tanish. Lekin gap murakkablashsa, masalan siyosat, ta’lim tizimi yoki texnologiya haqida bahs bo‘lsa, so‘z topish qiyinlashadi. Aynan shu joyda B2 boshlanadi.
scenes.say_uz: B1 da siz tanish mavzularda gapirasiz, tajribangizni tasvirlaysiz va fikringizga qisqa sabab keltirasiz.

scenes.title: B2 nimani talab qiladi
scenes.say: At B2 you can interact with native speakers without strain. You can explain a viewpoint and compare the advantages and disadvantages of different options.
scenes.say_native: Yevropa umumiy andozasiga ko‘ra B2 da siz ona tilida so‘zlashuvchi bilan hech bir tomon zo‘riqmasdan, tabiiy suhbatlasha olasiz. Murakkab matnlarni asosiy g‘oyasi bo‘yicha tushunasiz, keng mavzularda batafsil yozasiz va fikringizni qo‘llab, variantlarning afzalliklari va kamchiliklarini taqqoslaysiz. Buning uchun uchta ustun kerak: ravonlik, aniqlik va boylik. Hammasini birma-bir ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say_uz: B2 da siz so‘zlashuvchilar bilan zo‘riqmasdan muloqot qilasiz, fikringizni tushuntirasiz va variantlarning afzalliklari hamda kamchiliklarini taqqoslaysiz.

scenes.title: Ravonlik (fluency)
board: Pauses to think ≠ pauses to find words
scenes.say: Fluency means a smooth flow of ideas. Short pauses to plan are natural, but long stops to search for a basic word are not.
scenes.say_native: Ravonlik tez gapirish degani emas. Bu fikrning uzilmasdan oqishi. Ona tilida so‘zlovchilar ham to‘xtab o‘ylaydi, bu normal. Farq shundaki, B2 da siz fikrni rejalashtirish uchun qisqa to‘xtaysiz, B1 da esa oddiy so‘z topish uchun uzoq jim qolasiz. Ravonlikni oshirishning kaliti — mukammal gap emas, gapni davom ettira olish ko‘nikmasidir.
scenes.say_uz: Ravonlik fikrning uzluksiz oqimidir. Rejalashtirish uchun qisqa to‘xtash tabiiy, lekin oddiy so‘z qidirib uzoq to‘xtash tabiiy emas.

scenes.title: Ravonlik: B1 va B2 javob
board: Q: Do you enjoy your job?
B1: Yes. It is good. I like it.
B2: Yes, mostly. What I like is the variety, though it can get stressful.

examples.t: Yes, mostly, although it can get stressful.
examples.uz: Ha, asosan, garchi ba’zan zo‘riqish bo‘lsa ham.

scenes.say: Do you enjoy your job? B1: Yes. It is good. I like it. B2: Yes, mostly. What I like is the variety, although it can get stressful at times.
scenes.say_native: Mana bir xil savolga ikki javob. B1 javobi to‘g‘ri, lekin qisqa va uzuq-yuluq: uchta alohida gap. B2 javobida esa fikr bir oqimda: “mostly” bilan javobni yumshatdik, “what I like is” bilan gapni boshladik, “although” bilan qarama-qarshi fikrni ulab qo‘ydik. Gaplar soni emas, ularning bir-biriga bog‘lanishi ravonlik taassurotini beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Ishingiz yoqadimi? B1: Ha. U yaxshi. Menga yoqadi. B2: Ha, asosan. Menga xilma-xillik yoqadi, garchi ba’zan zo‘riqtirsa ham.

scenes.title: Ravonlik tezlik emas
board: ✗ Speaking very fast with many errors and no pauses
✓ Steady pace, natural pauses, ideas linked
scenes.say: Speed is not fluency. A steady pace with natural pauses sounds much better than a fast, messy rush.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik o‘quvchi ravonlik uchun imkon qadar tez gapirishga urinadi. Bu xato. Tez, lekin chalkash va xatolarga to‘la nutq tinglovchini charchatadi. Baholovchilar ham tezlikka emas, bir maromdagi tabiiy oqimga e’tibor beradi. Shoshilmang, fikrni bog‘lovchilar bilan ulang va to‘xtaganingizda “well” yoki “let me think” kabi iboralardan foydalaning.
scenes.say_uz: Tezlik ravonlik emas. Tabiiy to‘xtashlar bilan bir maromdagi nutq shoshqaloq va chalkash nutqdan ancha yaxshi eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Qaysi biri B2?
board: 1) I like football. It is fun.
2) I enjoy football, mainly because it brings people together.
scenes.say: Look at the board. Which answer sounds more like B2: the first or the second? Why?
scenes.say_native: Doskadagi ikki javobni solishtiring. Qaysi biri B2 ga yaqinroq? Nima uchun? Sabab, bog‘lovchi va fikrning rivojlanishiga e’tibor bering. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting. Ikkala gap ham grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri, shuning uchun aniqlikka emas, fikrning rivojlanishiga qarang.
scenes.say_uz: Doskaga qarang. Qaysi javob B2 ga o‘xshaydi: birinchisimi yoki ikkinchisi? Nega?

scenes.title: Javob
board: reason (mainly because) + wider idea (brings people together)

examples.t: I enjoy football, mainly because it brings people together.
examples.uz: Futbol menga yoqadi, asosan odamlarni birlashtirgani uchun.

scenes.say: The second one. It gives a reason, and the idea is bigger than just liking something.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob — ikkinchisi. Unda “mainly because” bilan sabab berilgan, fikr esa oddiy “qiziq” so‘zidan kengroq: futbol odamlarni birlashtiradi. Birinchi gap xato emas, ammo u B1 darajasida. B2 ga o‘tish — xatosiz gapirishdan ko‘ra, fikrni sabab va misol bilan kengaytirishdir.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchisi. Unda sabab berilgan va fikr oddiygina yoqtirishdan kengroq.

scenes.title: Aniqlik (accuracy)
board: Accuracy = correct grammar and word choice
B2: few errors, and they don’t block meaning
scenes.say: Accuracy means using grammar and words correctly. At B2 you make some mistakes, but they rarely stop people understanding you.
scenes.say_native: Aniqlik — grammatika va so‘z tanlashning to‘g‘riligi. B2 da hali xato qilasiz, lekin ular kam va ma’noga xalaqit bermaydi. Eng muhimi, o‘zingiz xatoni payqab, o‘sha zahoti to‘g‘rilay olasiz. Masalan: “He go... he goes to work by bus.” Bunday o‘zini tuzatish B2 ning kuchli belgisi. Demak, xatodan qo‘rqmang, lekin uni sezishni o‘rganing.
scenes.say_uz: Aniqlik grammatika va so‘zlarni to‘g‘ri ishlatishdir. B2 da ba’zi xatolar bo‘ladi, lekin ular tushunishga xalaqit bermaydi.

scenes.title: B1 da qotib qolgan xatolar
board: tenses: I am living here since 2020
scenes.say: Some errors stay for years. Articles, tense choice and prepositions are the most common ones for Uzbek speakers.
scenes.say_native: B1 da paydo bo‘lgan ayrim xatolar yillar davomida o‘zgarmay qoladi. Ularni “qotib qolgan xatolar” deymiz. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun “a”, “the” ni tushirib qoldirish juda keng tarqalgan. Yana zamonlar: o‘zbekchada “uch yildan beri yashayman” deymiz, inglizchada esa present perfect kerak. Old qo‘shimchalar ham muammo tug‘diradi. Bu xatolarni aniqlab olib, atay ustida ishlash kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi xatolar yillar davomida qoladi. O‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar uchun eng keng tarqalganlari artikllar, zamon tanlash va old qo‘shimchalardir.

scenes.title: Uchta odatiy xato
scenes.say: I’ve been living here since 2020. She is good at maths. I have a meeting today.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoga qarang. Birinchisi: “since” bilan oddiy hozirgi zamon ishlatilmaydi, “have been living” kerak. Ikkinchisi: “good in” emas, “good at”, chunki iboraning o‘zi shunday. Uchinchisi: sanaladigan birlik ot oldidan artikl kerak: “a meeting”. Bu gaplar B1 darajasida tushunarli, lekin B2 da ularni deyarli xatosiz aytishingiz kutiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Men 2020 yildan beri shu yerda yashayman. U matematikadan kuchli. Bugun mening uchrashuvim bor.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 2) I live in London since May.
scenes.say: Each sentence has one mistake. Find it and say the correct sentence.
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapda bitta xato bor. Uni toping va to‘g‘ri variantni baland ovozda ayting. Old qo‘shimcha, zamon va sanalmaydigan otni eslang. Shoshilmang: avval old qo‘shimchani, keyin zamonni, oxirida otning turini tekshiring. O‘zbekchadan tarjima qilib o‘ylasangiz, xato ko‘rinmay qoladi.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapda bitta xato bor. Uni toping va to‘g‘ri gapni ayting.

scenes.title: Xatolar javobi
board: 2) I’ve lived in London since May.
3) some advice / a piece of advice

examples.t: I’ve lived in London since May.
examples.uz: Men may oyidan beri Londonda yashayman.

scenes.say: Interested in music. I’ve lived in London since May. Some advice, because advice is uncountable.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “interested in”, “on” emas. “Since May” bilan present perfect: “I’ve lived”. Uchinchisida “advice” sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun “an advice” bo‘lmaydi, “some advice” yoki “a piece of advice” deymiz. O‘zbekchada “maslahat” ni sanash mumkin, inglizchada esa yo‘q. Aynan shunday farqlar xatoning ildizi.
scenes.say_uz: Interested in music. Since May bilan present perfect. Advice sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun some advice.

scenes.title: Boylik (range)
board: Range = variety of words and structures
scenes.say: Range means variety. At B2 you choose more precise words and use different structures instead of repeating the same ones.
scenes.say_native: Boylik — so‘zlar va tuzilmalar xilma-xilligi. B1 da “good”, “bad”, “nice” va “very” so‘zlari hamma joyda uchraydi. B2 da esa aniqroq so‘z tanlaysiz: “good” o‘rniga “worthwhile”, “beneficial” yoki “reliable”, “bad” o‘rniga “harmful” yoki “disappointing”. Shuningdek, bir xil gap qurilishini takrorlamay, har xil tuzilmalardan foydalanasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Boylik xilma-xillikdir. B2 da aniqroq so‘zlarni tanlaysiz va bir xil tuzilmalarni takrorlamaysiz.

scenes.title: Oddiy so‘zni almashtirish

examples.t: There has been a substantial increase.

scenes.say: It was a worthwhile experience. The results were disappointing. There has been a substantial increase in prices.
scenes.say_native: Mana “good”, “bad” va “big” o‘rniga ishlatish mumkin bo‘lgan so‘zlar. Har birining o‘z ma’no nozikligi bor: “worthwhile” — qilgan mehnatingizga arziydigan, “disappointing” — kutganingizdan past, “substantial” — sezilarli darajada katta. Yangi so‘zni yodlaganda uni albatta bitta to‘liq gapda yozib qo‘ying, shunda uni nutqda ishlatish osonlashadi.
scenes.say_uz: Bu arziydigan tajriba bo‘ldi. Natijalar hafsalani pir qildi. Narxlar sezilarli oshdi.

scenes.title: Very + kuchli sifat
scenes.say: We do not say very exhausted. We say absolutely exhausted, or really tired.
scenes.say_native: Kuchli sifatlar o‘zi allaqachon eng yuqori darajani bildiradi, shuning uchun “very exhausted” deyilmaydi. To‘g‘ri variantlar: “absolutely exhausted” yoki oddiy sifat bilan “really tired”. O‘zbek tilida “juda a’lo” desak ham bo‘ladi, shuning uchun bu xato bizda ko‘p uchraydi. Bu qoida ingliz tiliga xos, uni shunchaki yodlab oling.
scenes.say_uz: Very exhausted demaymiz. Absolutely exhausted yoki really tired deymiz.

scenes.title: So‘zni yangilang
board: 2) I was very tired after the trip.
scenes.say: Upgrade the words in each sentence. Replace good, very tired and very big with more precise words.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapdagi oddiy so‘zlarni aniqroq so‘zlar bilan almashtiring. “Good film” o‘rniga nima desa bo‘ladi? “Very tired” o‘rniga-chi? “Very big” o‘rniga-chi? Gapni to‘liq ayting. Bu yerda bitta to‘g‘ri javob yo‘q, har bir gapga bir nechta variant topish mumkin. Qancha ko‘p variant aytsangiz, shuncha yaxshi mashq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapdagi oddiy so‘zlarni aniqroq so‘zlar bilan almashtiring.

scenes.title: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar
board: 1) It was a gripping / moving film.
2) I was exhausted after the trip.

examples.uz: Bu qiziqarli, o‘ziga tortadigan film edi.

scenes.say: It was a gripping film. I was exhausted after the trip. The house is enormous.
scenes.say_native: Mana variantlar: “It was a gripping film” — zo‘r, o‘ziga tortadigan film. “I was exhausted after the trip.” “The house is enormous.” Boshqa to‘g‘ri variantlar ham bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan “a brilliant film” yoki “huge”. Asosiysi, so‘zingiz gapga mos bo‘lsin. Ko‘p variant bilish — sizning boyligingiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bu o‘ziga tortadigan film edi. Sayohatdan keyin juda charchadim. Uy ulkan.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ikki do‘st
board: Anna: My English hasn’t improved for months.
Ben: Maybe you’re only using what you already know.
Anna: Yes, I always avoid difficult grammar.
scenes.say: Anna: My English hasn’t improved for months. Ben: Maybe you’re only using what you already know. Anna: You’re right. I always avoid difficult grammar, so I never really practise it. Ben: Then challenge yourself. Try one new structure every day.
scenes.say_native: Endi qisqa suhbatni tinglang. Anna inglizcha oylardan beri o‘smayotganidan shikoyat qiladi. Do‘sti Ben esa sababni topadi. Savollarga e’tibor bering: Anna nima qiladi va Ben nima maslahat beradi? Birinchi marta umumiy ma’noni tushunishga harakat qiling, hamma so‘zni tushunish shart emas. Kerak bo‘lsa, ikkinchi marta qayta tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Inglizcham oylardan beri yaxshilanmayapti. Ben: Balki sen faqat bilganingni ishlatayotgandirsan. Anna: To‘g‘ri. Men doim qiyin grammatikadan qochaman, shuning uchun uni mashq qilmayman. Ben: Unda o‘zingni sina. Har kuni bitta yangi tuzilmani sinab ko‘r.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
scenes.say: Two questions. First, why is Anna not improving? Second, what does Ben advise her to do?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita savol. Birinchisi: Anna nega rivojlanmayapti? Ikkinchisi: Ben unga nima qilishni maslahat beradi? Suhbatni eslab, javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling, bu ham nutq mashqi. Suhbatni xotirangizda qayta eslang, kerak bo‘lsa ikkinchi marta tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita savol. Anna nega rivojlanmayapti? Ben unga nima qilishni maslahat beradi?

scenes.title: Suhbat javoblari
board: 1) She avoids difficult grammar, so she never practises it.
2) To try one new structure every day.
scenes.say: She avoids difficult grammar. Ben advises her to try one new structure every day.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Anna qiyin grammatikadan qochadi, shuning uchun uni hech qachon mashq qilmaydi. Ben esa har kuni bitta yangi tuzilmani sinab ko‘rishni maslahat beradi. Shu kichik suhbatda B1 dagi to‘xtab qolishning asosiy sababi aytildi: biz o‘zimizga qulay narsalarni takrorlayveramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Anna qiyin grammatikadan qochadi. Ben har kuni bitta yangi tuzilmani sinab ko‘rishni maslahat beradi.

scenes.title: B1 platosi nima
board: Comfort zone = same words, same tenses
scenes.say: A plateau is when progress seems to stop. Often the reason is that your English is already good enough for daily life.
scenes.say_native: Plato — yuqoriga ko‘tarilish to‘xtab, tekis joyga chiqib qolish. Ko‘pchilik B1 da shunday his qiladi. Sababi oddiy: ingliz tilingiz kundalik hayot uchun yetarli, shuning uchun miya yangi narsani o‘rganishga ehtiyoj sezmaydi. Siz tanish so‘zlar va oddiy zamonlar bilan hamma narsani aytib bera olasiz. Natijada rivojlanish sezilmaydi, garchi aslida siz hali ko‘p o‘rganishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say_uz: Plato bu rivojlanish to‘xtab qolgandek tuyuladigan holat. Ko‘pincha sabab shuki, tilingiz kundalik hayot uchun yetarli bo‘lib qolgan.

scenes.title: Qochish strategiyasi
board: Avoidance: using only words you are sure of

examples.t: I would have called if I had known.

scenes.say: Avoidance means you only use what is safe. To break the plateau, take small risks with new words and structures.
scenes.say_native: Qochish strategiyasi shuni anglatadi: siz faqat xavfsiz, ishonchli so‘zlar va zamonlarni ishlatasiz. Masalan, murakkab gap o‘rniga uni qismlarga bo‘lib oddiy zamonda aytasiz. Bu xatodan saqlaydi, lekin rivojlanishdan ham saqlaydi. Davosi — kichik, rejalashtirilgan tavakkal: har kuni bitta yangi so‘z yoki tuzilmani, xato qilishdan qo‘rqmay, nutqda sinab ko‘rish.
scenes.say_uz: Qochish xavfsiz narsalardan chiqmaslikdir. Platodan chiqish uchun yangi so‘z va tuzilmalar bilan kichik tavakkal qiling.

scenes.title: B2 o‘quv rejasi: tamoyil
board: Little and often > long and rare
scenes.say: A good plan has three parts: input, output and review. Little and often works better than long, rare sessions.
scenes.say_native: Endi reja. Yaxshi reja uch qismdan iborat: kirish ma’lumot, ya’ni o‘qish va tinglash, chiqish, ya’ni gapirish va yozish, hamda takrorlash. Eng muhim tamoyil: kam, lekin muntazam. Haftada bir marta uch soat o‘tirgandan ko‘ra, har kuni o‘ttiz-qirq besh daqiqa ishlash ancha samarali. Til mushak kabi: doimiy yuklama bilan o‘sadi.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi reja uch qismdan iborat: kirish, chiqish va takrorlash. Kam, lekin muntazam ishlash uzoq va kamdan-kam mashg‘ulotdan yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Kirish: o‘qish va tinglash
board: Extensive: for pleasure, lots, don’t stop
Intensive: short text, study every detail
Sources: podcasts, news, series, graded readers
scenes.say: Use two kinds of input. Extensive input is for pleasure and volume. Intensive input is for studying a short text in detail.
scenes.say_native: Kirish ikki xil bo‘ladi. Keng qamrovli: qiziqarli podkast, serial yoki kitobni lug‘atga qaramay, umumiy ma’noni tushunib ko‘p o‘qish va tinglash. Chuqur: qisqa matnni, masalan besh daqiqalik audio yoki bitta maqolani, har bir so‘z va tuzilmasigacha o‘rganish. Birinchisi tilni sezishga, ikkinchisi aniqlikka yordam beradi. Ikkalasi ham kerak. Hafta davomida ularni almashtirib turing.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki xil kirish ishlating. Keng qamrovli kirish zavq va hajm uchun, chuqur kirish esa qisqa matnni batafsil o‘rganish uchun.

scenes.title: Chiqish: gapirish va yozish
board: Speak: record yourself 2 min, 3 times a week
Write: one short paragraph a day
scenes.say: Output is where progress becomes visible. Record yourself speaking and write a short paragraph regularly.
scenes.say_native: Chiqish — rivojlanish ko‘rinadigan joy. Haftada kamida uch marta ikki daqiqa o‘zingizni yozib oling va tinglang. Har kuni qisqa paragraf yozing. Eng muhimi, qaytar aloqa olish: o‘qituvchi, til sherigi yoki matn tekshiruvchi. Aks holda xato o‘zgarmay qolaveradi. O‘zingizga qulay mavzuni emas, ba’zan qiyinroq mavzuni tanlang, chunki aynan shunda yangi so‘z kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Chiqishda rivojlanish ko‘rinadi. O‘zingizni yozib oling va muntazam qisqa paragraf yozing, qaytar aloqa oling.

scenes.title: Lug‘at daftari: so‘z birikmalari
board: But: make a decision / reach a decision

examples.t: We need to make a decision soon.
examples.uz: Tez orada qaror qabul qilishimiz kerak.

examples.t: There was heavy rain all day.

scenes.say: Learn words in chunks, not alone. We make a decision, not do a decision. We say heavy rain, not strong rain.
scenes.say_native: B2 da yakka so‘zlarni emas, birikmalarni o‘rganing. Ularni kollokatsiya deymiz. Inglizcha “make a decision”, “do homework”, “heavy rain”. Agar “strong rain” desangiz, tushunishadi, lekin tabiiy eshitilmaydi. O‘zbekchada “qaror qabul qilish” deymiz, inglizchada esa fe’l “make” bo‘ladi: tarjima qilib “accept a decision” desangiz, noto‘g‘ri chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zlarni yakka emas, birikma sifatida o‘rganing. Make a decision, heavy rain deymiz.

scenes.title: Samarasiz o‘rganish odatlari
board: ✗ Only apps and games, no speaking
✓ Films with English subtitles, then without
✓ Speak every week, even to yourself
scenes.say: Apps are fine, but they are not enough. Watch with English subtitles, and speak every week.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tuzoq. Birinchisi: faqat ilovalar bilan shug‘ullanib, hech qachon gapirmaslik. Ikkinchisi: filmni o‘zbekcha yoki ruscha subtitr bilan ko‘rish: miya o‘qishga o‘tib ketadi, tinglamaydi. Uchinchisi: faqat yangi mavzu o‘rganib, eskisini takrorlamaslik. Yaxshisi: ingliz subtitrlari bilan ko‘ring, keyin subtitrsiz, va haftada bir marta albatta gapiring, hatto o‘zingiz bilan bo‘lsa ham.
scenes.say_uz: Ilovalar yaxshi, lekin yetarli emas. Ingliz subtitrlari bilan ko‘ring va har hafta gapiring.

scenes.title: Haftalik reja namunasi
board: Fri: write a paragraph, correct it
scenes.say: Here is a sample week. Monday: a podcast and five new chunks. Wednesday: a two-minute recording. Friday: a paragraph. Sunday: review.
scenes.say_native: Mana haftalik reja namunasi. Dushanba: o‘ttiz daqiqalik podkast va beshta yangi birikma. Chorshanba: ikki daqiqalik audio yozuv. Juma: paragraf yozish va tuzatish. Yakshanba: daftarni takrorlash. Boshqa kunlar yengil bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan bir dars yoki qisqa video. Reja real bo‘lsin: bajara olmaydigan reja ishlamaydi. Siz o‘zingizga mos kunlarni tanlashingiz mumkin, masalan ishdan keyin yoki ertalab. Muhimi, vaqt aniq belgilangan bo‘lsin va kalendaringizga yozib qo‘yilsin.
scenes.say_uz: Mana namunaviy hafta. Dushanba: podkast va beshta yangi birikma. Chorshanba: ikki daqiqalik yozuv. Juma: paragraf. Yakshanba: takrorlash.

scenes.title: Ravonlik uchun talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar
board: a cup of tea → /ə kʌp əv ˈtiː/
Stress the key words, reduce the rest
scenes.say: In natural speech small words are weak. A cup of tea sounds like a cup uv tea. Stress the key words and reduce the rest.
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy ingliz nutqi ritmik: muhim so‘zlar urg‘u oladi, kichik so‘zlar esa kuchsiz va qisqa aytiladi. “Of” aslida /əv/, “to” /tə/, “and” /ən/, “can” /kən/ deb eshitiladi. “A cup of tea” — “ə kap əv ti”. Agar har so‘zni to‘liq va teng kuch bilan aytsangiz, nutq sun’iy chiqadi va ravonlik yo‘qoladi. Tinglaganda ham aynan shu shakllarni tanib olishni o‘rganing.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy nutqda kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi. A cup of tea ‘ə kap əv ti’ kabi eshitiladi. Muhim so‘zlarga urg‘u bering.

scenes.title: Bog‘lanish (linking)
scenes.say: When a word ends in a consonant and the next starts with a vowel, we link them. Turn it off sounds like turn-it-off in one flow.
scenes.say_native: Bog‘lanish — ravonlikning yana bir sirri. Agar so‘z undosh bilan tugab, keyingisi unli bilan boshlansa, ular birga oqib o‘tadi. “Turn it off” — “tur-ni-toff” kabi eshitiladi. “Pick it up” — “pi-ki-tup”. Siz uni bo‘laklarga bo‘lib emas, bir nafasda aytasiz. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday: “keldi-yu” ni bir oqimda aytamiz. Endi uni inglizchada mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Undosh bilan tugagan so‘z unli bilan boshlangan so‘zga bog‘lanadi. Turn it off bir oqimda eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Takrorlang va bog‘lang
board: A cup of tea and a piece of cake.
scenes.say: Repeat after me. Turn it off. Pick it up. A cup of tea and a piece of cake.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Har bir gapni uzmay, bir oqimda ayting. Kichik so‘zlar, ya’ni “of” va “and”, kuchsiz bo‘lsin. Birinchi gap: “Turn it off.” Keyin “Pick it up.” Oxirida uzunroq gap. Birinchi marta sekin ayting, keyin tezlashtiring. Kichik so‘zlarni ataylab kuchsiz va qisqa aytishga harakat qiling, ular deyarli eshitilmasin.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang. Uni o‘chiring. Uni ko‘taring. Bir finjon choy va bir bo‘lak tort.

scenes.title: Talaffuz izohi
scenes.say: Good. In each phrase the key words are strong and the small words are weak.
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. E’tibor bering, har bir iborada ma’noli so‘zlar kuchli, kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz. “Turn it off” da “turn” va “off” urg‘uli, “it” kuchsiz. Uzun gapda ham xuddi shunday: cup, tea, piece, cake kuchli. Agar shunday qila olsangiz, nutqingiz birdaniga ancha tabiiy eshitiladi. Buni har kuni ikki daqiqa mashq qilsangiz kifoya.
scenes.say_uz: Har iborada ma’noli so‘zlar kuchli, kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash: o‘qituvchi va talaba
board: Teacher: How did your recording go?
Student: I spoke for two minutes but I paused a lot.
Teacher: Let’s check fluency, accuracy and range.
scenes.say: Teacher: How did your recording go? Student: I spoke for two minutes, but I paused a lot and repeated the word nice. Teacher: Good. Let’s check fluency, accuracy and range one by one. Student: I think my range is the weakest.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir suhbat. O‘qituvchi talabadan yozuvi qanday o‘tganini so‘raydi. Talaba ikki daqiqa gapirgani, ammo ko‘p to‘xtagani va “nice” so‘zini takrorlaganini aytadi. Savollarga e’tibor bering: u qaysi mezonni eng zaif deb hisoblaydi va uning muammolari nima?
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: Yozuv qanday o‘tdi? Talaba: Ikki daqiqa gapirdim, lekin ko‘p to‘xtadim va nice so‘zini takrorladim. O‘qituvchi: Yaxshi. Ravonlik, aniqlik va boylikni birma-bir tekshiramiz. Talaba: Menimcha, eng zaifi boylik.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1) How long did the student speak?
2) Which criterion is the weakest, and why?
scenes.say: How long did the student speak? Which criterion does the student think is the weakest, and why?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita savol. Talaba qancha gapirdi? Va u qaysi mezonni eng zaif deb hisoblaydi, sababi nima? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling, bu ham nutq mashqi. Suhbatni xotirangizda qayta eslang, kerak bo‘lsa ikkinchi marta tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Talaba qancha gapirdi? U qaysi mezonni eng zaif deb hisoblaydi va nega?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Two minutes. Range is the weakest, because the student repeated the word nice.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: talaba ikki daqiqa gapirgan. Eng zaif mezon — boylik, chunki u “nice” so‘zini qayta-qayta ishlatgan. Ko‘ryapsiz, o‘zini baholash aynan shunday ishlaydi: yozuvni tinglaysiz, takrorlarni payqaysiz va aniq nuqtani topasiz. Ana shu aniqlik keyingi mashg‘ulotlaringizga yo‘nalish beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki daqiqa. Eng zaifi boylik, chunki talaba nice so‘zini takrorlagan.

scenes.title: O‘zini baholash jadvali
scenes.say: Score yourself from one to five on fluency, accuracy, range and pronunciation. Be honest and give an example for each score.
scenes.say_native: O‘zini baholash uchun to‘rt mezon yetarli: ravonlik, aniqlik, boylik va talaffuz. Har biriga bir dan besh gacha ball qo‘ying. Muhim qoida: har bir ballga misol keltiring. Masalan, “ravonlik 3: uch marta uzoq jim qoldim”. Misolsiz ball ishonchsiz. Birinchi bahodan keyin ikki hafta o‘tgach qayta baholang, shunda siz o‘z rivojlanishingizni ko‘rasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Ravonlik, aniqlik, boylik va talaffuzni bir dan besh gacha baholang. Har ballga misol keltiring.

scenes.title: Namunani baholang
board: ‘Yes, I like travel. Travel is nice. I went to Turkey. It was nice. The food was nice.’
scenes.say: Read the sample talk on the board. How would you score its range from one to five? Give a reason.
scenes.say_native: Doskadagi namunaga qarang. Bu nutqning boyligiga bir dan besh gacha qanday ball berasiz? Sababini ham ayting. Qaysi so‘z takrorlanyapti va uni nima bilan almashtirish mumkin? Takrorlanadigan so‘zni, gaplarning uzunligini va bog‘lovchilar bor-yo‘qligini tekshiring. Javobingizni asoslash uchun doskadagi matndan misol keltiring.
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi namunaviy nutqni o‘qing. Uning boyligiga bir dan besh gacha qanday ball berasiz? Sababini ayting.

scenes.title: Baholash javobi
board: Better: Travel broadens the mind. Turkey was fascinating, and the food was delicious.
scenes.say: Range is one or two. Nice is repeated three times. Better: Turkey was fascinating, and the food was delicious.
scenes.say_native: Bu nutq uchun boylikka bir yoki ikki ball munosib. “Nice” uch marta takrorlangan, gaplar juda qisqa. Yaxshiroq variant: “Turkey was fascinating, and the food was delicious.” Ko‘rdingizmi, bitta takrorlangan so‘zni almashtirishning o‘zi nutqni boyitadi. O‘z yozuvingizda ham aynan shuni qidiring.
scenes.say_uz: Boylik bir yoki ikki ball. Nice uch marta takrorlangan. Yaxshiroq: Turkiya hayratlanarli edi, ovqat esa mazali edi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: ikki daqiqalik nutq
board: Topic: My life and my English
Use: because, although, so, for example
scenes.say: Now your task. Plan a two-minute talk about you and your English. Say where you are now, how you started, and your plans.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z nutqingizni tayyorlaymiz. Mavzu: hayotingiz va ingliz tilingiz. Tuzilma oddiy: hozir, o‘tmish, kelajak rejalar. Hozirgi holatingizni ayting, ingliz tilini qanday boshlaganingizni va nimani maqsad qilganingizni tushuntiring. Albatta kamida ikkita bog‘lovchi va bitta misol ishlating: “because”, “although”, “for example”. Hozir qisqa fikr yozib oling.
scenes.say_uz: Endi vazifa. Hayotingiz va ingliz tilingiz haqida ikki daqiqalik nutq rejalashtiring: hozir, o‘tmish va rejalar.

scenes.title: Bir daqiqa mashq
scenes.say: Try the first part now. Speak for twenty seconds. Use because, although or for example at least once.
scenes.say_native: Hozir ishlab ko‘ramiz. Yigirma soniya davomida gapiring. Hozirgi holatingiz, ingliz tilini qachon boshlaganingiz va rejangiz haqida ayting. Kamida bitta bog‘lovchi ishlating. To‘xtab qolsangiz, “let me think” deb davom eting. Mukammal bo‘lishi shart emas, maqsad to‘xtamasdan gapirishdir. Xato qilsangiz, to‘xtab, o‘zingizni tuzating va davom eting, bu ham B2 ko‘nikmasi.
scenes.say_uz: Hozir birinchi qismni sinab ko‘ring. Yigirma soniya gapiring. Kamida bir marta because, although yoki for example ishlating.

scenes.title: Namunaviy nutq
board: I work as a nurse, although I’d like to move into management.
I started English at school, but I only began to practise seriously last year.
For example, I now listen to a podcast every day.
scenes.say: I work as a nurse, although I’d like to move into management. I started English at school, but I only began to practise seriously last year.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. “I work as a nurse, although I’d like to move into management.” “I started English at school, but I only began to practise seriously last year.” Va misol: “For example, I now listen to a podcast every day.” Sizniki albatta boshqacha bo‘ladi. Muhimi, tuzilma bir: hozir, o‘tmish, reja va bog‘lovchilar. Endi uni uyda to‘liq yozib oling.
scenes.say_uz: Men hamshiraman, garchi boshqaruvga o‘tishni istasam ham. Ingliz tilini maktabda boshlaganman, lekin jiddiy mashq qilishni o‘tgan yilgina boshladim.

scenes.title: Xulosa
scenes.say: Let us recap. B2 means fluency, accuracy and range. Break the plateau with small risks, a weekly plan, and honest self-assessment.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. B2 uch ustunga tayanadi: ravonlik, aniqlik va boylik. B1 platosidan qochish strategiyasini tark etib, kichik tavakkal qilib chiqasiz. Reja uch qismdan iborat: kirish, chiqish va takrorlash. Va nihoyat, o‘zingizni muntazam, misollar bilan baholab turing. Bu usullar kichik ko‘rinadi, lekin bir necha oy ichida katta farq beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: B2 ravonlik, aniqlik va boylikdir. Platodan kichik tavakkal, haftalik reja va halol baholash bilan chiqasiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Score it: fluency, accuracy, range, pronunciation
scenes.say: Homework: record a two-minute talk about yourself and your English. Then score it against the four criteria.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: ikki daqiqalik nutqingizni yozib oling va to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zingizni baholang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir mezon uchun bitta aniq misol va bitta keyingi maqsad yozilgan bo‘lsin. Yozuvingiz kamida ikki daqiqa davom etsin. Keyingi darsda zamonlarning nozik farqlarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz va ingliz tilingiz haqida ikki daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling va to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha baholang.

homework_uz: Ikki daqiqalik nutqingizni (o‘zingiz va ingliz tilingiz haqida) yozib oling. Ravonlik, aniqlik, boylik va talaffuzni 1–5 ball bilan baholang. Har bir mezon uchun bitta aniq misol va keyingi bir maqsad yozing.

quiz.q: Which sentence sounds most like B2?
options: I like my job. It is good.
I like my job, mainly because it is varied.
quiz.why_uz: B2 da fikr sabab bilan kengaytiriladi: mainly because.
Ravonlik tezlik emas, fikrning uzluksiz oqimidir.
Kuchli sifat bilan very emas, absolutely ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: What is 'avoidance' at the B1 plateau?
options: Using only safe words and structures
quiz.why_uz: Qochish strategiyasi — faqat xavfsiz narsalarni ishlatish.

quiz.q: In natural speech, 'of' in 'a cup of tea' is usually pronounced:
options: not at all, the word is omitted

quiz.q: A good way to self-assess your recording is to:
options: Score it and give an example for each score
Ask no one and change nothing
quiz.why_uz: Har bir ball misol bilan asoslanishi kerak.
